subject: Shine Circular
text: The SP consumption of Shine Circular is increased to 150.

evidence.quote: シャインサーキュラーの消費SPが150に上昇

subject: Hard Mode
text: Hard mode is added and selectable when starting a new game from the 2nd playthrough onward, with increased enemy levels.

evidence.quote: ハードモード追加。2周目以降ニューゲーム開始時に選択可。敵のレベルが上昇している。
evidence.translation: Hard mode added. Selectable when starting a new game from the 2nd playthrough onward. Enemy levels are increased.

subject: Non-heroine PC characters
text: Non-heroine PC characters have decreased SP consumption and increased sword skill usage rate.

evidence.quote: ヒロイン以外のPCキャラの消費SP減少、ソードスキル使用率向上
evidence.translation: Non-heroine PC characters SP consumption decreased, sword skill usage rate increased.

subject: Ultimate Ruler
text: Selecting Forgotten Guardian at the 76th floor teleport gate screen initiates a battle with Ultimate Ruler, whose boss level is 150 on Normal Mode.

evidence.quote: 76層の転移門画面にて忘却の番人を選択するとアルティメットルーラーとのバトルになる。...ボスのレベルはノーマルモードで150（本編ボスのヒースクリフが140）。
evidence.translation: Selecting Forgotten Guardian at the 76th floor teleport gate screen initiates a battle with Ultimate Ruler. Boss level is 150 on Normal Mode (main story boss Heathcliff is 140).

subject: Labyrinth of Condemnation
text: Players enter from the 76th floor teleport gate screen and cannot escape until defeating Fatal Reaper at the deepest part.

evidence.quote: 76層の転移門画面より突入する。...最深部でフェイタルリーパーを撃破するまで脱出不可。
evidence.translation: Enter from the 76th floor teleport gate screen... Cannot escape until defeating Fatal Reaper at the deepest part.

subject: Fatal Reaper
text: Fatal Reaper is at the deepest part and cannot escape until defeating it, with its level being the same as Ultimate Ruler.

evidence.quote: 最深部でフェイタルリーパーを撃破するまで脱出不可。レベルはアルティメットルーラーと同じ。
evidence.translation: Cannot escape until defeating Fatal Reaper at the deepest part. Level is the same as Ultimate Ruler.

subject: Labyrinth of Condemnation
text: Treasure chests respawn infinitely every time you enter, but there are one-way branching paths and you cannot obtain all treasure chests at once.

evidence.quote: 宝箱は入る度に無限に復活するが、一方通行の分かれ道があり一度に宝箱を全て取得することは出来ない。
evidence.translation: Treasure chests respawn infinitely every time you enter, but there are one-way branching paths and you cannot obtain all treasure chests at once.

subject: School Swimsuit
text: Entering the code allows you to buy as many school swimsuits as you like at the 76th floor armor shop for 5万 col.

evidence.quote: 初回生産分の購入特典。コードを入れると76層の防具屋にて5万colで好きなだけ買えるスクール水着。
evidence.translation: First production bonus. Entering the code allows you to buy as many school swimsuits as you like at the 76th floor armor shop for 5万 col.

subject: School Swimsuit
text: Other body armor is guaranteed 30 defense, but this has only 15 defense, while providing bonuses of 10 to attack power, 50 to AGL, and 8% to evasion rate.

evidence.quote: 他の体防具は防御力30は保証されているがこちらは防御力は15しかなく、これは軽装タイプの腕防具と同等。...一応攻撃力に10、AGLに50、回避率に8%の補正はつく。
evidence.translation: Other body armor is guaranteed 30 defense, but this has only 15 defense, equivalent to light arm armor... It provides bonuses of 10 to attack power, 50 to AGL, and 8% to evasion rate.
